test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 8 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Illicit
solution:
The correct answer is 'Ethical'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Illicit is an adjective that means **forbidden by law, rules, or custom.**

 
 
• *Example - Between 2018 and 2020, 45 **illicit **production laboratories were discovered in the EU.*
 
 
 
• The meanings of the given options are as follows - 
 
 
• Unlawful - not conforming to, permitted by, or recognized by law or rules.
 
• Furtive - attempting to avoid notice or attention, typically because of guilt or a belief that discovery would lead to trouble; secretive.
 
• Prohibited - that has been forbidden; banned.
 
• Ethical - morally good or correct.
 
 
 
• From the above meanings, it is evident that 'ethical' is the correct antonym for the word 'illicit'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The words unlawful and prohibited are synonyms of the word illicit.
